ala-archa.name: Ala-Archa National Park
ala-archa.description: Walk alpine trails to a panoramic waterfall and breathe the crisp mountain air beneath the snowy Tien Shan peaks. A perfect first day in Kyrgyzstan.

pio-peak.name: Lenin Peak: Achik-Tash Base Camp
pio-peak.description: A journey to the foot of a legendary 7,000-metre peak: Pamir-Alay glaciers, the high-altitude Achik-Tash camp and ridges stretching to the horizon.

asan-basky.name: Asan-Basy Valley
asan-basky.description: A quiet valley of high pastures and snowy slopes, ideal for a short yet refreshing escape into the mountains.

lenin-trail.name: Kegeti Pass Trek from the Chuy Valley
lenin-trail.description: A classic mountain crossing: the Kegeti waterfall, alpine meadows, a 3,800-metre pass and a descent into the Kochkor valley.

issyk-kul.name: Lake Issyk-Kul
issyk-kul.description: Enjoy a morning beside Kyrgyzstan’s great mountain lake, sandy beaches and snow-capped peaks, with welcoming guesthouses and local culture along the way.

son-kul.name: High-Altitude Son-Kul Lake
son-kul.description: Experience nomadic life at 3,016 metres: sleep in a yurt beneath the stars, ride across open pastures and enjoy the quiet of the highlands.

chatyr-kul.name: Chatyr-Kul Lake
chatyr-kul.description: Discover a remote high-mountain lake of wide-open views, fresh winds and starry nights in a traditional nomadic camp.

kashka-suu.name: Kashka-Suu Lake and Mountain Escape
kashka-suu.description: Take an easy break by the water, walk to a waterfall and enjoy a relaxed outdoor trip suited to families.

jyrgalan.name: Jyrgalan Valley
jyrgalan.description: Walk through green pastures and beneath snowy peaks on quiet trails far from the crowds. A lovely place for fresh air and an easy hike.

ala-kul.name: Trek to Ala-Kul Lake
ala-kul.description: Cross mountain passes and alpine meadows before reaching a crystal-clear lake on this rewarding trek for experienced hikers.

kara-mazar.name: Kara-Mazar Trail
kara-mazar.description: Follow calm mountain paths through vivid wildflowers, with riverside stops and a comfortable pace for different fitness levels.

seren-peak.name: Trek in the Seren Mountain Range
seren-peak.description: A rewarding high-altitude adventure with steep climbs, remote landscapes and star-filled nights for travelers who love the outdoors.

skazka.name: Fairy Tale Canyon
skazka.description: Explore red rock formations beside Issyk-Kul that glow at sunset. The easy walk offers unforgettable views and great photo spots.

toraygyr.name: Toraygyr Canyon
toraygyr.description: Sandstone walls and sunlit, colorful hills create a distinctive setting for an active getaway and memorable photographs.

jeti-oguz.name: Jeti-Oguz Gorge
jeti-oguz.description: The famous “Seven Bulls” and “Broken Heart” rocks, a mountain river and a spruce-filled gorge — a vivid route with a relaxed pace and beautiful stops.

myn-tala.name: Myn-Tala Canyon
myn-tala.description: Spend a comfortable day among striking rock formations and ever-changing landscapes on an easy, photo-friendly route.

sary-chet.name: Naryn River Canyons
sary-chet.description: A challenging but spectacular route across rugged terrain, with cliffs above the Naryn River, high passes and long panoramic views.

song-kul-horse.name: Horseback Ride in the Tien Shan
song-kul-horse.description: Ride ancient mountain trails with an experienced local guide, who will match the route to your ability and share nomadic traditions.

rafting-chui.name: White-Water Rafting on the Chu River
rafting-chui.description: Enjoy an energetic but guided rafting trip through lively rapids and calmer stretches, framed by broad gravel banks.

paragliding.name: Paragliding over Lake Issyk-Kul
paragliding.description: Soar above vivid blue water with snowy peaks on the horizon in one of Kyrgyzstan’s most scenic adventures.

horse-steppe.name: Nomadic Horse Trail
horse-steppe.description: Meet local families, stay in yurts and ride across open steppe to experience the rhythms and traditions of nomadic life.

mountain-bike.name: Mountain Bike Ride over a High Pass
mountain-bike.description: Ride challenging descents with wide views of the mountain ranges, then spend the night at a high-altitude camp.

karakol.name: Karakol and the Tien Shan Gorges
karakol.description: Explore historic Karakol, nearby mountain gorges and forest trails at the foot of the Tien Shan with a local guide.

sary-chelek.name: Sary-Chelek Lake
sary-chelek.description: Visit a protected mountain lake surrounded by walnut forests, quiet coves and the landscapes of a UNESCO biosphere reserve.

arslanbob.name: Arslanbob Walnut Forests
arslanbob.description: Walk through vast walnut forests, visit waterfalls and discover the welcoming culture of local communities.

tash-rabat.name: Tash-Rabat Caravanserai
tash-rabat.description: Visit a medieval stone caravanserai on the Silk Road, set among the broad high-altitude valleys of Naryn.

kel-suu.name: Kel-Suu Lake
kel-suu.description: See a turquoise lake enclosed by sheer cliffs. The route includes a drive through a high mountain valley and time by the water.

burana.name: Burana Tower and Ancient Balasagun
burana.description: Learn about the medieval city of Balasagun, visit Burana’s minaret and see ancient stone statues.

bishkek.name: Bishkek: Parks, Markets and City Life
bishkek.description: Discover leafy boulevards, central squares and lively markets in the capital with a knowledgeable local guide.

chunkurchak.name: Chunkurchak Gorge
chunkurchak.description: Just outside Bishkek, enjoy pine forests, mountain meadows, panoramic views and easy trails in the fresh air.

altyn-arashan.name: Altyn-Arashan Hot Springs
altyn-arashan.description: A hike through a pine-forested gorge to a high valley with yurts and hot radon springs at the foot of Palatka Peak.

barskoon.name: Barskoon Waterfalls
barskoon.description: A scenic gorge on the south shore of Issyk-Kul: the “Snow Leopard’s Tears” waterfalls, the Gagarin monument and views of the glaciers.
